**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user has been building models for about 6 weeks.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Airbrushing can be intimidating at first, but practice and patience can lead to amazing results.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended a dual-action airbrush (internal mix) as a good starting point for model building.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested starting with a low air pressure of around 10-15 PSI and adjusting as needed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised thinning acrylic paints to a mixture of 1 part paint to 1-2 parts thinner for airbrushing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Emphasized the importance of regular cleaning of the airbrush to prevent clogs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided techniques to practice, including basic spray pattern, controlling flow, layering, edge control, freehand painting, masking, and blending.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed common mistakes to avoid, such as over-spraying, inconsistent pressure, and not thinning paint.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested practicing on a test surface before painting the model.
